provenance.method: Plastic MIP PREDICTED from the Y-88 absolute scale (no clean triple-MIP exists - see y88_report discrepancy). After Y-88-edge equalization the 699 keVee edge = 31.2 mV on every PMT, so gain = 44.6 mV/MeVee and a 3.4 MeV MIP (Landau MPV, 2 cm PVT) sits at ~152 mV.
caveats: MIP is PREDICTED, not measured - re-take a low-rate/prompt-beam MIP run to confirm and replace mip_peak_mV_fleet
nonlinearity: equalized at 0.699 MeV, so the MIP (3.4 MeV) is uniform only to ~+-12%; arm A/DL run ~15-20% low (per_pmt below). Use per_pmt.half_mip_mV for a uniform TRIGGER point.
thresholds are digitizer-equivalent mV; map to hardware discriminator units.

scaling: threshold_mV = fraction * mip_peak_mV. HOW TO SCALE TOGETHER: mip_peak_mV moves with the global gain g set via pss/global_gain_slide_y88_fifo.csv, i.e. mip_peak_mV(g) = 152 * g. So pick a fraction of MIP and, whenever you change g, re-set threshold = fraction * 152 * g.
